ratings.comment: Really interesting class and the material isn't too difficult. The readings aren't bad either because the material is interesting and relevant. Exams were short answer and there was a group presentation. As long as you put in effort, you will do fine.

Worst professor I've ever had at UW Madison. Is not helpful, doesn't set clear grading criteria, such terribly boring lectures. DO NOT take this class if you're expecting an easy A, she grades harshly. Finished my 3rd semester and this is the first class I've regret taking

Great class, great professor. Material was really interesting, lots of the readings were fairly current news articles which I liked a lot. Textbook was easy to read, interesting, and helpful. Discussions were really interesting. Grading was fair and she gives lots of feedback which is really helpful.

Not a conducive environment for anyone who doesn't agree with her thoughts. Doesn't give grading criteria, but grades extremely harshly. World renowned sociologist, worst class worst professor I've ever had.

She was never really clear about what she was looking for, even when people would directly ask her what she wanted us to know. You also had to go out of your way to go talk to her, because she would always bolt out of the door right when the bell rang because she clearly did not want to be in class. Also makes rude remarks to students when she can.

Myra is certainly a scholar. The class focuses on improving your skills in sociological research. The topics are interesting and you can tailor what you learn to your own interests. She may come off as imtimidating but the class isn't as hard as she makes it seem. Can miss a reasonable amount of class and skim some readings.

This woman is very rude, condescending, and not helpful. I hated going to class. Her feedback on papers in not helpful and often very mean. What I learned in this class is from primarily other students and some of her lectures. She does not run a seminar well and is not encouraging at all. Only take her class if you want to feel like crap.

Myra obviously knows her stuff, but she comes off as pretty condescending. She's helpful but, once again, I can't emphasize enough how condescending she is. She can be intimidating. At first, she grades kind of hard, but then she gets more and more lenient with time. Learn to understand the material her way and you'll be set for the most part.

To quote "Matilda," I'm pretty sure this thought is going through Myra's head at all times: "I'm smart. You're dumb. I'm big. You're little. I'm right. You're wrong, and there's nothing you can do about it." Full of herself. Thinks she's helping you when in reality she's just telling you how much you suck. I wouldn't recommend the class to anyone.

This teacher is amazing. She is so committed to intellectural rigor and she supports her students completely, especially those who work hard and love learning. She is amazing resource on gender and society too.
Myra Marx Ferree is an awesome professor and an amazing scholar.  She is one of the greatest feminist thinkers and teachers currently in sociology!

I thought the material in the class was very interesting; her lectures were boring at times, but nothing was too hard to understand. Her assignments were confusing at first, but once I figured out I didn't have to answer every part of the sheet in my papers, it was easy. Not very helpful to talk to.
it was ok...the final exam was graded poorly which gave me an AB instead of an A...i'd recommend the class, but probably not the professor.  she is a liberal weanie!!!

She is a femnazi. If you do not agree with her, you are wrong. She is the most boring lecturer I have had in my 3 years at this university. Her grading is not difficult, but not even the ta's liked her. I do not recommend her to anyone (despite an interest) because this class is about feminism only.

Very fair class if you enjoy analysis and writing; leans to the left wing! The workload is not bad if you pace yourself, but the lectures can get pretty boring.  If you're interested in the topic, the class itself is definitely worth taking, but you have a different option for the prof, go for it
